range-rover.file: File:2022 Land Rover Range Rover SE P440e AWD Automatic 3.0 Front.jpg
range-rover.author: Vauxford
range-rover.alt: Range Rover (L460, standard wheelbase) in a light gold metallic, front three-quarter view
range-rover.note: Fifth-generation L460 Range Rover (current model): slim headlamps, flush glazing and vertical side 'gills'. UK-market car; the CBU/locally assembled Indian L460 looks the same. Standard-wheelbase body (India sells SWB and LWB).

range-rover.file: File:2022 Land Rover Range Rover SE P440e AWD Automatic 3.0 Rear.jpg
range-rover.author: Vauxford
range-rover.alt: Range Rover (L460, standard wheelbase) in a light gold metallic, rear three-quarter view
range-rover.note: Same L460 car: hidden-until-lit vertical tail lamps and the black tailgate band of the current Range Rover.

range-rover.file: File:2022 Land Rover Range Rover SE P440e AWD Automatic 3.0 Side.jpg
range-rover.author: Vauxford
range-rover.alt: Range Rover (L460, standard wheelbase) in a light gold metallic, side profile
range-rover.note: Same L460 car in profile; standard wheelbase (the LWB has a longer rear door).

range-rover.file: File:Land Rover Range Rover Autobiography L460 Deep Garnet (12).jpg
range-rover.author: Damian B Oh
range-rover.alt: Range Rover (L460) Autobiography interior with dark red leather front seats and dashboard
range-rover.note: L460 Autobiography cabin with the floating 13.1-inch touchscreen and current steering wheel; same interior design as Indian-market cars.

range-rover-sport.file: File:Range Rover Sport Series III IMG 9456.jpg
range-rover-sport.author: Alexander-93
range-rover-sport.alt: Range Rover Sport (L461, third generation) in grey metallic, front three-quarter view
range-rover-sport.note: Third-generation L461 Range Rover Sport (2022-on, current in India): slim headlamps, flush door handles, side vent. European car; design identical to the Indian model.

range-rover-sport.file: File:Range Rover Sport Series III IMG 9449.jpg
range-rover-sport.author: Alexander-93
range-rover-sport.alt: Range Rover Sport (L461) in grey metallic, rear three-quarter view
range-rover-sport.note: L461 rear with full-width light bar and 'SPORT' badge on the tailgate. Dealer plate holder visible.

range-rover-sport.author: Alexander-93
range-rover-sport.alt: Range Rover Sport (L461) dashboard with tan leather and floating touchscreen
range-rover-sport.note: L461 interior with the 13.1-inch curved touchscreen and current steering wheel. Photographed at a motor show; other stands are visible only blurred through the windscreen.

range-rover-velar.file: File:2023 Land Rover Range Rover Velar S in Varesine Blue Metallic, front right.jpg
range-rover-velar.author: Ethan Llamas
range-rover-velar.alt: Range Rover Velar (2023 facelift) in Varesine Blue, front three-quarter view
range-rover-velar.note: Facelifted Velar (MY2024 on, the version sold in India): new geometric grille, simplified bumper without corner blades, Varesine Blue launched with the facelift. Philippine-registered car; Indian CBU design is the same.

range-rover-evoque.author: Alexander Migl
range-rover-evoque.alt: Range Rover Evoque (L551 facelift) in silver-grey, front three-quarter view
range-rover-evoque.note: Facelifted second-generation Evoque (MY2024 on): new geometric grille pattern replacing the earlier hexagonal mesh, checked on a crop. German car; same design as the Indian model.

range-rover-evoque.author: Alexander Migl
range-rover-evoque.alt: Range Rover Evoque (L551 facelift) in silver-grey, rear three-quarter view
range-rover-evoque.note: Same facelifted car (plate S RR 206) from the rear.

range-rover-evoque.file: File:Land Rover Range Rover Evoque S L551 Cloud Ebony (6).jpg
range-rover-evoque.author: Damian B Oh
range-rover-evoque.alt: Range Rover Evoque (L551 facelift) cabin with light grey leather, seen through the driver's door
range-rover-evoque.note: Korean-market MY2025+ Evoque S: new steering wheel and single curved touchscreen layout of the facelift.

land-rover-defender.author: Alexander Migl
land-rover-defender.alt: Land Rover Defender 110 (L663) in blue-grey, front three-quarter view
land-rover-defender.note: Current L663 Defender 110 (five-door). European car; the Defender 110 sold in India is the same body. The 2025 model-year update changed only headlamp graphics and the screen.

land-rover-defender.author: Alexander Migl
land-rover-defender.alt: Land Rover Defender 110 (L663) in blue-grey, rear three-quarter view
land-rover-defender.note: Same Defender 110 from the rear: side-hinged tailgate with spare wheel.

land-rover-defender.author: Oleg Yunakov
land-rover-defender.alt: Land Rover Defender 110 (L663) in satin green with black wheels, side profile
land-rover-defender.note: 2025 Defender 110 (V8 trim, red calipers) in profile; the 110 body and side glazing are the same as on Indian 110 variants.

land-rover-discovery.file: File:2024 Land Rover Discovery P300 S, front left, 09-12-2026.jpg
land-rover-discovery.author: MercurySable99
land-rover-discovery.alt: Land Rover Discovery (L462 facelift) in dark blue metallic, front three-quarter view
land-rover-discovery.note: Facelifted fifth-generation Discovery (2021 on): slimmer headlamps with new DRL signature and reshaped bumper. US car (2024 model year); same exterior as the Indian Discovery.

land-rover-discovery.file: File:2024 Land Rover Discovery P300 S, rear left, 09-12-2026.jpg
land-rover-discovery.author: MercurySable99
land-rover-discovery.alt: Land Rover Discovery (L462 facelift) in dark blue metallic, rear three-quarter view
land-rover-discovery.note: Same car: facelift tail lamps joined by the black tailgate panel with 'DISCOVERY' lettering.

land-rover-discovery.file: File:Land Rover Discovery Dynamic HSE L462 FL Fuji White (3).jpg
land-rover-discovery.author: Damian B Oh
land-rover-discovery.alt: Land Rover Discovery Dynamic HSE (L462 facelift) in Fuji White, side profile
land-rover-discovery.note: Facelifted Discovery in Dynamic trim (black accents), photographed in Korea.

land-rover-discovery-sport.note: 2024-model Discovery Sport (current L550 design, per the uploader's trim note) in Dynamic SE trim, Japan. Same exterior as the Discovery Sport sold in India.
